data.name: Chilling　Gooey　Internet　Cafe
data.detailed_description:
This reclusive man fell asleep in what should have been a familiar room, but when he woke up, he found himself in a dim, unsettling internet café. Why is he here? Where is the exit? All he knows is that he has to get out.

Chilling Gooey Internet Cafe is a first-person exploration horror game set in an internet café steeped in silence and unease, where the boundary between reality and nightmare has dissolved.

■ A Night You Stumbled Into
The protagonist is a typical shut-in — a weak-willed man who spends his days holed up in his room, endlessly surfing the internet. One day, after drifting off to sleep, he wakes up in an unfamiliar internet café room. The space feels unreal, subtly warped. Something monstrous wanders this place.

■ A Loop of Exploration and Return
Using the internet café as a home base, players venture into unknown maps in search of keys. Explore each map, solve its puzzles, complete your objective, and return to the café — repeat this cycle three times, and you'll finally obtain the key to the second floor. Beyond the final door awaits true escape.

■ Wandering Horrors
Unidentified beings lurk within this café — twisted imitations of familiar things, monstrous in their distortion. Characters that should be cute, corrupted beyond recognition; vividly colored creatures covered in countless hands; a massive presence closing in from the darkness. If you encounter them, your only choices are to hide or run.

■ Features

  • Immersive first-person exploration

  • Gameplay blending puzzle-solving with item collection

  • Unsettling, surreal, dreamcore-inspired visuals

  • Tense encounters demanding stealth and evasion

  • Playtime: approximately 3 hours

Late at night, in an empty internet café — what will you find? And will you make it back to "reality" safely?

data.short_description: A reclusive man falls asleep and wakes up in a nightmarish internet café haunted by twisted horrors — mutated moe characters, creatures crawling with hands. Explore, hide, and flee your way to freedom in this first-person horror where reality and nightmare blur. Playtime: ~3 hours.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

content_descriptors.notes: This game features horror elements, including encounters with unsettling, deformed creatures and sudden jump scares intended to startle the player. Combat and damage may include unrealistic, cartoonish violence (such as exaggerated bone-breaking effects), but does not include realistic depictions of blood or graphic injury. The game does not contain sexual content, depictions of drug or alcohol abuse, or self-harm.
